title: Adapt Filters Dialog
description: OpenUI5 Adapt Filters personalization: transactional filter values, visibility and order, List/Group views, search, Reset and keyboard reordering.

usage.summary: Personalize filter fields, their order and values in a staged dialog before applying changes.
useWhen: Let users choose which filters appear in the filter bar and change their order.
Let users find filters by name or group and edit conditions even for fields hidden from the bar.
Use filters with render functions for condition editors, and handle onApply to commit values and visibleKeys.

avoidWhen.when: Adjust sorting, grouping or predefined filter values for a list or table without personalizing filter fields.
Edit currently visible criteria inline without changing filter visibility or order.
Choose business values from a searchable result table or define conditions for one field.
